scope: single-model Kimi K2.5 G6/G7 execution recovery

findings.title: Historical G7 lifecycle failures remain retained after successful corrected retries
findings.evidence: New Kimi K2.5 run completed 150/150 states and 72/72 checkpoints; 13/13 retry-target latest traces pass, but historical raw lifecycle failures remain immutable and are not erased.
findings.remediation: Keep historical failures and corrected retry traces separately audited; do not relabel the historical denominator as clean without a protocol-approved reanalysis.

findings.title: Provider billing and immutable model identity remain unavailable
findings.evidence: Authenticated provider catalog returned HTTP 200 and service IDs including kimi-k2.5, but no immutable weight fingerprint or billing/usage export was returned; local trace usage remains non-confirmatory.
findings.remediation: Obtain provider-verifiable billing/usage reconciliation and immutable route or weight identity; keep scientific release closed until independently verified.

findings.title: Formal Q/math/statistical validity remains incomplete
findings.evidence: The isolated Q-v2 cohort has 92/92 successful responses with independent counts PASS 9, FAIL 3, INCONCLUSIVE 26, NOT_SCORED 54; the G6 CF3 retry public-only verifier has PASS 23, INCONCLUSIVE 62, NOT_SCORED 53; controlled exact revision validity is 0/138.
findings.remediation: Obtain independent domain-grade mathematical and statistical review and preregister the confirmatory denominator before any scientific inference or release.

findings.title: LU dependency/state evidence is still derivation-only
findings.evidence: Extended public-only LU-v2 construction produced 11 DAGs and 22/22 independently verified SymPy edges, but no observed model-state transition was available and U remains 0/0.
findings.remediation: Obtain an independently audited dependency/state dataset with observed model transitions; do not convert public derivations into model-behavior or U evidence.

findings.title: Historical G7 terminal/Q coverage issue remains non-confirmatory
findings.evidence: The corrected run now has 150/150 completed state records and the separate Q-v2 cohort has 92/92 provider responses, but these new non-confirmatory artifacts do not retroactively change the historical denominator or release gate.
findings.remediation: Keep new execution evidence separate from the frozen historical denominator and obtain independent scientific review before changing the formal gate.
